template.title: Milo's Magic Kite
template.summary: A gentle story about Milo learning to ask for help and sharing joy with a puppy while flying a kite.

sentences.text_with_blanks: Milo loved to play with his [[slot_toy]] in the [[slot_place]].
The [[slot_toy]] was bright [[slot_color]] and looked like a rainbow dragon.
He tried to lift it up, but the wind blew it down.
He almost put the [[slot_toy]] on the ground and say goodbye.
Then he remembered his [[slot_pet]] who loved to chase butterflies.
Milo whispered, "Come on, [[slot_pet]]! Let's help me."
The [[slot_pet]] wagged its tail and jumped, catching the kite's string.
Together, they lifted the kite higher, and it sang a soft [[slot_sound]].
Milo and his [[slot_pet]] shared a [[slot_snack]] while watching the kite dance.
The kite flew over the [[slot_place]] and painted the sky with colors.
Milo felt happy and thanked his friend.
They promised to play again tomorrow.
